description: Example fallback chains for agent-model-healer. Copy to $ZOUROBOROS_CONFIG_DIR/agent-model-healer/fallback-chain.json, replace the example model ids with models your Hermes profile can reach (add "provider" where the model needs a Hermes provider override), then run `healer.ts validate`. Automatic healing stays off (healingEnabled=false) until you have reviewed a dry run.

_policy.probeTiming: healthyResponseMs=20000 (completed responses at/above are degraded; each hermes -z probe pays ~8 s of CLI startup; AGENT_MODEL_HEALER_HEALTHY_RESPONSE_MS overrides); timeoutMs=30000 strictly above it and in whole seconds, so slow-but-complete responses are distinguishable from timeouts. Timeouts record latencyMs=null.
_policy.watchmen: Schedule the healer as a no_agent Hermes cron job whose script runs `healer.ts auto`, so it has no model dependency of its own. Never add a model the healer depends on to a chain it heals.

probeConfig.prompt: You are a health check responder. List the numbers 1 through 10, each on its own line. After the list, write exactly: HEALTH_CHECK_PASS
